gameplay_features.combat: 'Style-weaving' combat — seamless switching between melee, ranged and magic with no frame delay; evolved from the classic Strength/Skill/Will triad. Includes the chicken-transformation spell (enemies can be turned into chickens and kicked).
gameplay_features.open_world: True open world — a franchise first. Albion explorable early; Bowerstone is a fully traversable central hub city.
gameplay_features.morality_system: Returning good/evil morality with new twists: alignment shaped by the player's actions AND by how NPCs perceive them. (The phrase 'subjective, multi-perspective morality' from the task prompt: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED — perception-based reactions confirmed, exact mechanics not detailed.)
gameplay_features.npc_count: 1,000+ handcrafted, fully-voiced NPCs ('Living Population') with names, roles, daily routines and personalities
gameplay_features.npc_interactions: NPCs have simulated lives; their worldviews influence reactions to the player. Nearly all ~1,000 NPCs can be romanced/married (small set of exceptions).
gameplay_features.multiplayer: NONE — single-player only (confirmed via Steam categories and press). No co-op (a step back from Fable 2/3), no PvP/PvE.

not_confirmed: Bloodstone — NOT CONFIRMED in any 2026 source found

gameplay_features.customization: Expanded character customization: appearance, clothing, scars, tattoos
gameplay_features.life_sim_layer: Property and business ownership, marriage/romance with nearly all NPCs, raising children (multiple children possible)

features_cut_vs_legacy: Dog companion — NOT CONFIRMED either way in sources found

Planned worldwide release (Xbox Series X|S, PC, PS5, Game Pass day one)
